name: Wendy's Spicy Chicken Sandwich (WARNING)
whyItWorks: A thick chicken breast dredged in seasoned batter with black pepper, cayenne, and paprika, deep-fried in vegetable oil and slathered with mayonnaise. High capsaicin and trans fats spark immediate gut hypermotility and diarrhea.
